item.title: Seattle Jewish Film Festival coming to SJCC
item.description: Mercer Island’s Stroum Jewish Community Center will be hosting the 31st annual Seattle Jewish Film Festival with a bevy of movie showings at the J from March 19-29. Showings are occurring from March 14-18 at Seattle venues.

item.title: Celebrating the life and legacy of Ari Grashin at basketball tournament
Brewer and Hardy’s omnibus hearings continued to April
item.description: More than two years after Mercer Island resident Curtis Engeland’s body was recovered in the Grays Harbor County city of Cosmopolis on March 7, 2024, the two defendants who pleaded not guilty to charges of first-degree murder and more still have not participated in their omnibus pre-trial hearings.

item.title: National Weather Service issues wind advisory for Puget Sound region
item.description: A wind advisory remains in effect from 3 p.m. Wednesday, March 11 through 6 a.m. Thursday, March 12 throughout much of the Puget Sound region, including King County.

item.title: No Kings rallies set for March 28 across King County
Mercer Island continues to focus on compliance with comprehensive plan
item.description: Ever since the city of Mercer Island learned of an appeal to its 2024 comprehensive plan and a need for compliance by July 31, City Manager Jessi Bon said they’ve been in “gas pedal down mode.”

item.title: Federal Way double murder suspect captured in Mexico
item.description: One hour and 13 minutes after the suspect was placed on the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list, he was captured in Culiacán, Sinaloa, Mexico.

item.title: Koehler thrives as a pitcher and leader for MIHS baseball squad
item.description: It’s safe to say that Chase Koehler is thrilled to get his senior baseball season underway.

item.title: Shot on a disposable camera: WA state basketball 2026
item.description: In a world of advancing technology, take a step back and dive into a bit of nostalgia.

item.title: Public can weigh in on the city’s Transportation Improvement Program
item.description: As Mercer Island’s Transportation Improvement Program (TIP) update rolls along, residents are encouraged to participate in the process by submitting feedback to the city.
